amendment_reason: Pre-outcome precision strengthening. The historical P1 H2 planning threshold is approximately 2401 controls; v2.2.1 used an even 2400-control grid. Before any confirmatory world is materialized, raise the control grid to 2402 (1201 evidence-only + 1201 execution-only), preserving every mechanism, parent, margin and seed. Also pre-bind a second disjoint replication seed so a positive primary run cannot choose its replication after outcome access.

power_basis.H2_boundary: Control precision now exceeds the historical prospective requirement; no sub-resolution selectivity claim is permitted.

candidate_visible: public repair candidates with action level, coordinate, equal unit cost and overlapping confidence
public diagnostic menu with neutral ids/descriptions and equal unit cost
public dependency graph without hidden response outcomes
intervention outcomes only after the arm spends the corresponding unit
host_only: counterfactual response matrix for every repair/intervention
which of two high-level target-flipping proposals preserves protected siblings
fresh_world_plan.pre_arm_freeze: Materialize WORLD_PUBLIC.jsonl + PROTECTED_RESPONSE_MATRIX.jsonl + WORLD_FREEZE.json with exact count/hashes/leak audit before any arm output.

replication_rule.primary_acceptance: direction and all protected safety gates must replicate; replication is reported separately and is never pooled into the primary confirmatory verdict
